name: Viridescent-Threnody
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a binary sunset, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Instruments disagree about the radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
